title: zMItemsBuilder
description: Advanced items, kits and sets system
body:
# ⚔️ zMItemsBuilder ### Advanced Item, Armor Set & Kit System for Minecraft > **Build once. Reuse everywhere.** > > Create powerful custom items, scalable equipment, complete armor/tool sets, and reusable kits with a clean and optimized configuration. --- ## ✨ Why zMItemsBuilder? Most item plugins simply create custom items. **zMItemsBuilder** was designed to build complete progression systems. Whether you're creating an **OP Prison**, **KitPvP**, **RPG**, **Skyblock**, or **Factions** server, the plugin lets you manage every item from a single configuration while automatically scaling enchantments, formatting, rarities, and restrictions. --- # 🚀 Main Features | Feature | Description | | -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | | 🛡 Armor Sets | Automatically generate complete armor sets. | | 🛠 Tool Sets | Create full tool collections in seconds. | | ⚔ Custom Items | Weapons, keys, coins, consumables and any custom item. | | 📈 Level System | Dynamic enchantments based on item level. | | 🎨 Formatting Engine | Gradients, placeholders and automatic color generation. | | 🔒 Restrictions | Prevent dropping, crafting, placing, enchanting and much more. | | 🧩 Reusable Items | Define an item once and reuse it in unlimited kits. | | 📦 Kit System | Build scalable kits using existing items. | | 🌎 Multi Language | English and Spanish included. | | ⚡ Optimized | Lightweight, clean and designed for large servers. | --- # 📈 Dynamic Enchantment Scaling Create progression systems without duplicating configurations. Supports multiple scaling methods: * ✅ Linear Scaling * ✅ Interval Scaling * ✅ Static Values Perfect for: * Prison Servers * RPG Progression * Rankup Systems * OP Servers * PvE Equipment --- # 🎨 Advanced Formatting Customize every detail of your items. ### Included Features * Gradient support * RGB colors * Automatic secondary colors * Custom prefixes * Dynamic placeholders Example placeholders: ``` {level} {rarity} {enchants} {item_type} {amount} ``` --- # 🔒 Item Restrictions Prevent players from abusing custom items. Supported restrictions include: * Drop Item * Crafting * Smelting * Stonecutter * Grindstone * Anvil * Smithing Table * Enchanting Table * Block Placement * And much more... --- # 📦 Reusable Kit System Instead of configuring every item repeatedly... Simply create the item once. Then reuse it across unlimited kits while preserving: * Levels * Rarities * Formatting * Enchantments * Restrictions This keeps configurations cleaner and easier to maintain. --- # 🆔 Item Identity Every item can include its own identity using: * NBT IDs (`id_item`) * Custom Model Data * Resource Pack compatibility Perfect for preventing fake copies and identifying plugin items. --- # ⚡ Quick Item Creation Create a fully configured item with a single command. ```text /zmitems create objects &#F13713&lS&#E13E1F&lP&#D1452A&lE&#C14C36&lC&#D1452A&lI&#E13E1F&lA&#F13713&lL ``` --- # 🎮 Commands | Command | Description | | ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | | `/zmitems create ` | Creates a new base item. | | `/zmitems enchant ` | Adds, updates or removes enchantments. | | `/zmitems rename ` | Renames the held item. | | `/zmitems lore` | Edits item lore. | | `/zmitems reload` | Reloads plugin files. | --- # 🔐 Permissions ```text zmitemsbuilder.use zmitemsbuilder.create zmitemsbuilder.reload ``` --- # 🖼 Preview Create professional-looking items in just seconds. *(Insert your screenshots here.)* --- # 💡 Perfect For * ⚔ OP Prison * 🏹 KitPvP * 🏰 Factions * 🧙 RPG * 🌌 Skyblock * 📦 Crates * 💰 Server Stores * 🎁 Rewards * 🏆 Rankup Systems ---
📚 Click to see everything zMItemsBuilder can create ### Equipment * Armor Sets * Tool Sets * Weapons * Pickaxes * Axes * Hoes * Shovels * Bows ### Economy * Coins * Tokens * Keys * Vouchers ### Rewards * Crates * Daily Rewards * Playtime Rewards * Battle Pass Rewards ### Utility Items * Restricted Items * Event Items * Cosmetic Items * Store Items * Donation Items And much more...
--- # ❤️ Built for Performance zMItemsBuilder was developed with scalability in mind. ✔ Clean configuration ✔ Reusable components ✔ Lightweight ✔ Easy to maintain ✔ Optimized for large servers --- # ⭐ Why Choose zMItemsBuilder? Unlike traditional item plugins, **zMItemsBuilder** combines custom items, scalable enchantments, reusable kits, formatting, and restrictions into a single optimized system. Build once. Reuse everywhere. Scale infinitely.
